name: Caphtorites
title: Peoples descended from Mizraim
summary: The Caphtorites were one of the peoples descended from Mizraim (Egypt) in the table of nations. The name is linked to Caphtor (often identified with Crete), which the Bible elsewhere associates with the origin of the Philistines.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the table of nations
keyEvents.description: The Caphtorites are listed among Mizraim's descendants in the genealogy of Ham.
